title: Why Every Slash in an IP Address Hides a Tiny Network

card_alts.card1: What a /24 CIDR actually means: 192.168.1.0/24 returns network, broadcast, subnet mask, and 254 usable hosts
card_alts.card2: Slash to address count cheat sheet: /30=2 hosts, /27=30, /24=254, /22=1022, /16=65534, /8=16M
card_alts.card3: IPv4 vs IPv6: /32 has 1 address, IPv6 /64 has 1.8×10^19 addresses. No broadcast, no subtraction in IPv6
